changes.now: Fury grows suspicious of Project Insight, three helicarriers built to kill threats before they happen, and is shot by the Winter Soldier. He fakes his death and trusts Steve and Natasha with the truth: HYDRA has been growing inside S.H.I.E.L.D. since its founding, led by Alexander Pierce. They bring down the helicarriers, and Natasha leaks every S.H.I.E.L.D. secret online. S.H.I.E.L.D. is finished, and Fury goes underground.

changes.evidence: Steve and Natasha learn of HYDRA from Arnim Zola's preserved consciousness in the Camp Lehigh bunker and themselves realize Pierce is HYDRA's leader; only afterward does Hill bring them to the safehouse where Fury, who faked his death, reveals his plan to sabotage the helicarriers. Fury does not give them the HYDRA truth.

changes.now: Decades later, S.H.I.E.L.D. agent Phil Coulson keeps trying to set up a debriefing with Tony Stark after he escapes Afghanistan, and helps Pepper Potts expose Obadiah Stane. When Tony tells the world he's Iron Man, S.H.I.E.L.D.'s director, Nick Fury, is waiting in his living room to tell him he isn't the only superhero in the world, and that Fury is building something called the Avengers Initiative.
